info.description: Unified social media inbox API. Read and respond to comments, DMs, reviews, and mentions across Instagram, Facebook, Threads, Google Business Profile, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube through a single REST API. X/Twitter and Trustpilot coming soon.
info.title: SocialAPI.AI

get.description: Returns all active social media accounts connected to the authenticated API key's workspace.

post.description:
Initiates account connection. For OAuth2 platforms returns an auth_url to redirect the user to.
For apikey/credentials platforms stores the credentials immediately and returns account_id.

get.description: Returns the candidate Google Business Profiles for a pending connection created when a Google login manages more than one Profile. Choose one with the select endpoint.
get.summary: Get a pending Google Profile selection

post.description: Promotes a pending connection into a connected account. For Google, pass platform_account_id to choose exactly one candidate Profile. For Facebook, pass page_ids with the subset of candidate Pages to assign to the brand. First selection wins; the pending connection is then consumed.
post.summary: Select a Google Business Profile or Facebook Pages to connect

400.description: platform_account_id or page_ids not in the candidate set

delete.description:
Soft-deletes a connected account. It will no longer appear in the accounts list
and all API calls using this account will return 404.

get.description: Returns the boards for a connected Pinterest account.

post.description: Creates a board on Pinterest and returns it.

delete.description: Deletes the board on Pinterest along with every pin saved to it. This cannot be undone.

patch.description: Update a board. Privacy accepts only PUBLIC or SECRET.

get.description: Returns platform-specific creator settings needed before publishing (privacy levels, interaction toggles, posting availability). Currently supported for TikTok only; other platforms return 501.

501.description: Platform does not support creator info

post.description: Enqueue an async analytics export job for a connected account. Subject to plan limits (exports per month, cooldown hours, concurrent export cap).

get.description: Returns platform-specific quota data for a connected account as a key/value map where values are remaining counts. Keys are platform-defined - for example Instagram returns `posts_remaining`. An empty object is returned for platforms without usage limits.

501.description: Platform does not expose usage limits

get.description: Fetches posts and stories where your brand account was mentioned or tagged. Results are sorted newest-first. Returns 501 for platforms that do not support mention tracking. Threads support is beta and requires the threads_manage_mentions permission, which is pending Meta App Review, so Threads accounts outside the app's tester roster return an upstream authorization error until it is granted.

parameters.description: Return only items created after this timestamp (RFC3339)
parameters.name: since

parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100, default 20)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Pagination cursor returned by the previous response
parameters.name: cursor

501.description: Platform does not support mention tracking

post.description: Replies, as a public comment, to a mention of the connected account, including on a third-party post where the normal comment-reply endpoint is not permitted. Provide media_id (the media/post the mention is on); set comment_id only when the mention was in a comment (omit it to reply to a mention in the post caption). Supported on Instagram and Facebook. Consumes 1 interaction credit.

501.description: Platform does not support replying to mentions

get.description: Returns pages (e.g. Facebook Pages) associated with a connected account.

patch.description: Update a page's is_default or is_active status.

get.description: Returns service announcements that are currently visible, newest first. Each item carries a `seen` flag for the calling user. `window_start` and `window_end` describe the announced maintenance window and are absent for non-maintenance announcements. Free operation, consumes no credits.

post.description: Records that the calling user has seen an announcement, so it is not shown again. Idempotent: repeat calls succeed without changing anything. Free operation, consumes no credits.

get.description: Returns every subscription tier with prices and resource limits, ordered from cheapest to most expensive. Prices are in USD. -1 means unlimited for limits and custom pricing for prices.
Returns all brands for the authenticated user with their connected account counts.

post.description: Creates a new brand for grouping connected social accounts. Each brand can have one account per platform.

400.description: Invalid request body or missing name

delete.description: Deletes a brand and deactivates all its connected accounts (sets is_active=false).

400.description: Invalid request body or missing name

get.description: Returns a paginated, filtered slice of the unified event log. Events cover post lifecycle, inbox activity, account changes, and webhook deliveries. Retention varies by plan tier; the response includes the user's current retention window.

parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response
parameters.name: cursor

get.description: Returns aggregated event counts for the requested window: totals, failure counts, breakdowns by category and error category, plus inbox-specific breakdown. Useful for dashboard summary cards.
Returns the 50 most recent export jobs for the authenticated user. Optionally filter by status.

parameters.description: Filter by status (pending, processing, completed, failed)
parameters.name: status

get.description: Returns the current status, progress, result download URL (presigned Excel), and report URL for an export job.
Returns the cached video data for a completed export, including metrics and optional AI-enriched fields (transcript, vision summary).

post.description: Submit feedback (bug report, feature request, or general comment). Stored for the team and forwarded to their notification channel.

get.description: Returns inbox posts that have comments, ordered by most-recently-commented. Supports filtering by account, platform, minimum comment count, and date range. Uses cursor-based pagination. YouTube has no webhooks, so YouTube commented posts are served live from the platform and only appear when the request is scoped with account_id (they are absent from the unfiltered aggregate); the live YouTube list returns a single page (no cursor).

parameters.description: Filter by brand ID (returns only posts from accounts in this brand)
parameters.name: brand_id

parameters.description: Filter by platform (instagram, facebook, threads, tiktok, linkedin)
parameters.name: platform

parameters.description: Only return posts with at least this many comments (default 0)
parameters.name: min_comments

parameters.description: Only return posts commented after this timestamp (RFC3339)
parameters.name: since

get.description: Returns comments for a specific inbox post, including per-platform capability flags (can_reply, can_delete, can_hide, can_like, can_private_reply). Comments are fetched live from the platform on every request. Uses cursor-based pagination.

parameters.description: Connected account ID that owns the post
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.description: Filter by moderation status: published (default), held_for_review, likely_spam. YouTube only; ignored by other platforms.
parameters.name: moderation_status

parameters.description: Order: recent (default) or relevance. YouTube only; ignored by other platforms.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: Keyword search across comment text (max 256 chars). YouTube only; ignored by other platforms.
parameters.name: q

200.description: Paginated list of comments with capabilities

post.description: Posts a reply on the platform. If comment_id is provided, replies to that specific comment (threaded reply); otherwise replies to the post itself (top-level comment). Consumes 1 interaction credit.

501.description: Platform does not support comment replies

delete.description: Deletes a comment on the platform and removes it from the inbox. Not all platforms support comment deletion - check the can_delete capability flag.

501.description: Platform does not support comment deletion

post.description: Hides a comment on the platform so it is not visible to the public, and marks it hidden in the inbox. Supported on Instagram, Facebook, Threads, and YouTube. Check the can_hide capability flag. Threads support is beta and requires the threads_manage_replies permission, which is pending Meta App Review, so Threads accounts outside the app's tester roster return an upstream authorization error until it is granted.

501.description: Platform does not support hiding comments

delete.description: Restores a previously hidden comment so it is publicly visible again. Supported on Instagram, Facebook, Threads, and YouTube. Threads support is beta and requires the threads_manage_replies permission, which is pending Meta App Review, so Threads accounts outside the app's tester roster return an upstream authorization error until it is granted.

501.description: Platform does not support hiding comments

post.description: Likes a comment on the platform as the connected account. Supported on Facebook and LinkedIn Page only (the Instagram API does not expose comment likes). Check the can_like capability flag.

501.description: Platform does not support comment likes

delete.description: Removes a like from a comment on the platform. Supported on Facebook and LinkedIn Page only (the Instagram API does not expose comment likes).

501.description: Platform does not support comment likes

post.description: Sends a direct message to the author of a comment. Only supported on Instagram and Facebook. Meta allows one private reply per comment, within 7 days of the comment; a second attempt or an expired window returns HTTP 400 with error code platform.instagram.private_reply_ineligible or platform.facebook.private_reply_ineligible. On Facebook the commenter's reply continues as a normal Messenger conversation; on Instagram the private reply does not open a standard 24-hour messaging window. Check the can_private_reply capability flag.
post.summary: Send a private reply to a commenter

400.description: Missing required fields, or comment not eligible for a private reply (platform.instagram.private_reply_ineligible, platform.facebook.private_reply_ineligible)

501.description: Platform does not support private replies

get.description: Returns paginated replies to a specific comment. Same response shape as top-level comments. Uses cursor-based pagination.

parameters.description: Platform comment ID to get replies for
parameters.name: commentId

parameters.description: Connected account ID that owns the post
parameters.name: account_id

200.description: Paginated list of replies with capabilities

501.description: Platform does not support comment replies

get.description: Returns paginated DM conversations for the authenticated user, optionally filtered by account, platform, and status.

parameters.description: Filter by brand ID (returns only conversations from accounts in this brand)
parameters.name: brand_id

parameters.description: Filter by Facebook/Instagram page ID (for multi-page accounts)
parameters.name: page_id

get.description: Returns a single inbox conversation by ID.

patch.description: Sets the status of a conversation to active or archived.

400.description: Invalid request body or status value

get.description: Returns paginated messages for an inbox conversation, newest first.

post.description: Sends an outgoing DM via the connected platform account and records it in the conversation.
post.summary: Send a message in a conversation

400.description: Invalid request body, missing required fields, or messaging window closed (Instagram code platform.instagram.window_closed: the recipient must message you first to reopen the 24-hour window)

403.description: Platform rejected the request (e.g. platform.instagram.permission_denied), or account requires reconnection (account.reconnection_required)

501.description: Platform does not support sending DMs

post.description: Adds or replaces the account's emoji reaction on a message. Send the emoji character itself. Supported on Instagram and Facebook Messenger.

parameters.description: Platform message ID to react to
parameters.name: messageId

400.description: Invalid body, missing account_id, or reaction is not a single emoji

501.description: Platform does not support message reactions

delete.description: Removes the account's emoji reaction from a message.
delete.summary: Remove a reaction from a message

parameters.description: Platform message ID to remove the reaction from
parameters.name: messageId

501.description: Platform does not support message reactions

post.description: Resets the unread count on a conversation to zero.

get.description: Returns the bytes of a mirrored inbound attachment. A pending fetch is waited on briefly; 504 means retry, not gone.

404.description: Unknown media, or not owned by the caller

503.description: Too many concurrent waiters, retry shortly

504.description: Fetch still in progress, retry shortly

get.description: Lists your review-capable connected Accounts, each with its live review summary (average rating, total count, last review time). Use this to build the reviews inbox navigation, then GET /inbox/reviews/{account_id} for one Account's reviews.
Returns one page of reviews for a single connected Account, newest first by default. Reviews are proxied live from the platform and not stored. Currently only Google Business Profile returns reviews.

422.description: Account platform does not support reviews (account.platform_unsupported)

post.description: Posts a public reply to a review on the platform (e.g. Google Business Profile). Consumes 1 interaction credit. On Google, replies are moderated: a successful response returns state PENDING and the reply is not publicly visible until it becomes APPROVED. A rejected reply is never published, and the reason is reported as policy_violation on the review.

422.description: Account platform does not support reviews (account.platform_unsupported)

get.description: Reports whether a sync is running for the given target and when that target last completed one. Poll this after POST /inbox/sync until state leaves "syncing", then refetch the conversation or message list.

parameters.description: Conversation ID, to report on a thread sync instead of the account's list
parameters.name: conversation_id

post.description: Refreshes an account's inbox from the platform. Add conversation_id to refresh a single thread instead. Returns immediately: poll GET /inbox/sync until state leaves "syncing". A sync already running for the same target is returned as-is rather than duplicated.

429.description: A sync for this target ran too recently. The Retry-After header carries the seconds to wait.

get.description:
Public endpoint (no auth). Validates the invite token and redirects the user
to the platform's OAuth authorization page. On successful OAuth callback,
the account is connected to the invite creator's brand.
Returns all invites (active and used/expired) for a brand, ordered by created_at DESC.

post.description:
Creates a single-use invite link for an external user to connect a social account to a brand.
The brand must not already have a connected account for the specified platform, and
no active (unused, unexpired) invite may exist for the same brand+platform combination.

409.description: Account or active invite already exists

delete.description: Marks an invite as used (revoked), preventing it from being redeemed.

404.description: Invite not found or already used

get.description: Returns all API keys for the authenticated user, including each key's scope and brand restrictions.

post.description: Generates a new API key for the authenticated user. Optionally restrict it to a set of scopes (see GET /keys/scopes) and/or brands. Empty scopes or brand_ids mean unrestricted.

400.description: Invalid request body, missing name, unknown scope, or invalid brand ID

get.description: Returns the catalog of scopes assignable to restricted API keys.

delete.description: Deactivates an API key. This is irreversible.

patch.description: Edits an existing key's name, scopes, and brand restrictions in place. The key value is unchanged (no new secret is issued). Empty scopes or brand_ids mean unrestricted. Requires a full-access key or the dashboard.

400.description: Invalid request body, missing name, unknown scope, or invalid brand ID

post.description: Issues a new secret for an existing key, keeping its id, name, scopes, and brand restrictions. The old key value stops working immediately. The new raw key is shown once. Requires a full-access key or the dashboard.

200.description: Key rotated (new raw key shown once)

get.description: Returns a paginated list of uploaded media files for the authenticated user.
Returns total bytes used, the plan limit, and file count for the authenticated user.

post.description: Upload a media file directly through the API server.

get.description:
Returns a presigned S3 PUT URL for client-side media upload. Upload the file directly
via HTTP PUT to the returned URL, then call POST /v1/media/:id/verify to confirm.
get.summary: Get a presigned media upload URL

post.description: Confirms that a presigned-URL upload completed successfully and marks the media as ready.

Exchanges an OAuth authorization code for a connected social account. Use this when
you handle the OAuth callback on your own server (proxy flow). For a single account
the response is a flat ConnectAccountResponse (HTTP 201). When a single OAuth flow
connects multiple accounts (e.g. Facebook Pages) the response is OAuthCallbackResponse.

requestBody.description: Platform, code, and metadata (redirect_uri + state required)

200.description: Google login manages multiple Business Profiles; select one

get.description: Beta. Returns trailing-30-day Page insight aggregates (followers, views, reach, post engagements, net follower change) for a connected Facebook Page. Access is limited to beta testers while the read_insights permission is in Meta App Review, and non-beta keys receive 403 platform.facebook.beta_required. Pages connected without the permission return 403 platform.facebook.insights_scope_missing and must be reconnected. The response shape may change without notice while this endpoint is in beta.

403.description: Beta access required, or Page connected without the insights permission

get.description: Lists every Page the login's stored credential can manage, live from Meta, merged with assignment state. Pages granted after the last OAuth exchange appear here without re-authenticating. assignable reflects tenancy only; the 5-page-per-brand cap is enforced when assigning.

post.description: Assigns one unassigned Page from this login to the given brand. Each Page belongs to exactly one brand. Each brand can connect up to 5 Facebook Pages, a hard cap. Assigning beyond that limit is refused.
post.summary: Assign a Facebook Page to a brand

403.description: Brand already has the maximum of 5 Facebook Pages (platform.facebook.page_cap)

409.description: Brand connected through a different login

get.description: Returns daily time series for a location: how many people saw it on Google Search and Maps, and how many then called, asked for directions, messaged, booked, ordered, or clicked through to the website. start_date and end_date are inclusive and formatted YYYY-MM-DD. metric takes a comma-separated list and defaults to every metric. A day with no activity comes back as a zero rather than a gap. Google publishes no retention window and no freshness lag for this data, so a recent day may still be filling in and an old range may return nothing.
get.summary: Get Google Business Profile performance metrics

parameters.description: Comma-separated metric names, defaults to all
parameters.name: metric

get.description: Lists the photos and videos on a location's public profile: its logo, cover, interior shots, and so on. This is profile media, not the media attached to a post. Set contributed=true to read the separate, read-only gallery of photos customers submitted; those items carry an attribution block that Google requires you to display as provided, unaltered.
get.summary: List a Google Business Profile location's media

parameters.description: Read the customer-contributed gallery instead of your own media
parameters.name: contributed

parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response
parameters.name: cursor

post.description: Attaches one photo or video to a location's public profile under the given category. media takes exactly one item in the same form the publishing endpoints accept: a stored media library id (source_type media_id), a public URL (url), or a reference to bytes you uploaded to Google yourself (platform_attachment_id). SocialAPI resolves a library id and hands Google a URL to fetch, and derives the photo or video format from the stored file, so you never set Google's own upload fields. Google limits a location to 10 edits per minute, and that limit cannot be raised.
post.summary: Add media to a Google Business Profile location

get.description: Returns one photo or video from a location's profile. mediaId accepts either the bare id or the full Google resource name returned by the list endpoint.
get.summary: Get one Google Business Profile media item

delete.description: Deletes one photo or video you added to a location's profile. Photos contributed by customers cannot be deleted through the API and return a permission error; use the takedown_url on the item instead.
delete.summary: Remove media from a Google Business Profile location

get.description: Returns the keywords people searched before seeing the location, aggregated by month over an inclusive YYYY-MM range. A low-volume keyword comes back with threshold and is_threshold=true instead of value: Google withholds the exact count and gives an upper bound, so treating a threshold as a count overstates the keyword. limit is capped at 100 by Google.
get.summary: Get the search keywords that surfaced a Google Business Profile

parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response
parameters.name: cursor

get.description: Lists every Business Profile location the login's stored credential can manage, live from Google, merged with assignment state. Locations added in Google Business Profile after the last authorization appear here without re-authenticating. assignable reflects tenancy only. login_email identifies the Google account itself, and is empty for a login authorized before it was captured.
get.summary: List a Google login's Business Profile locations

post.description: Assigns one location from this login to the given brand, without re-doing OAuth. Each location belongs to exactly one brand, and each brand holds at most one Google Business Profile.
post.summary: Assign a Google Business Profile location to a brand

400.description: Location is not accessible through this login, or already belongs to another brand

409.description: Brand already has a Google Business Profile

post.description: Accepts a pending collaboration invite on an Instagram media object, publishing the co-authored post to this account's feed. Call with the invited account, not the publishing account. Invites expire 14 days after they are sent.

parameters.description: Instagram media ID carrying the invite
parameters.name: mediaId

400.description: No pending invite for this account on this media

501.description: Platform does not support collaborators

post.description: Declines a pending collaboration invite on an Instagram media object. The post will not appear on this account's feed. Call with the invited account, not the publishing account.

parameters.description: Instagram media ID carrying the invite
parameters.name: mediaId

400.description: No pending invite for this account on this media

501.description: Platform does not support collaborators

get.description: Returns the collaborators invited on a co-authored Instagram post and the state of each invite (accepted, pending, declined). Readable only by the account that published the media: Meta scopes co-authored media data to the publisher, so a collaborating account cannot read this edge. Collaborators can only be invited when the post is created (platform_data.collaborators); Instagram exposes no API to add one to an already-published post.
get.summary: List collaborators on an Instagram post

parameters.description: Connected account ID (must be the publishing account)
parameters.name: id

501.description: Platform does not support collaborators

get.description: Returns the profile Instagram exposes for a messaging participant, including the follow relationship in both directions (is_user_follow_business, is_business_follow_user). Read live from Instagram on every call, never cached, because follow status changes the moment someone unfollows. Instagram only returns this data for users who have consented by messaging your account or tapping an icebreaker or the persistent menu; for anyone else this returns 403 platform.instagram.230, which means Instagram will not disclose the relationship and is NOT the same as "does not follow". Branch on that error rather than treating it as a negative. Fields name and profile_pic are absent for users who have set neither; the follow fields are still returned. profile_pic URLs expire after a few days, so do not store them.
get.summary: Get an Instagram messaging participant's profile

parameters.description: Instagram-scoped user ID (IGSID) of the participant, as returned in conversation payloads
parameters.name: participantId

403.description: User consent required (platform.instagram.230), or platform access not permitted for your plan

501.description: Platform does not support participant profiles

get.description: Returns the currently-active stories for a connected Instagram account. Stories are ephemeral and expire about 24 hours after posting; each item carries is_story and a computed expires_at in metadata. Returns 501 for non-Instagram accounts.

parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100, default 20)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Pagination cursor returned by the previous response
parameters.name: cursor

403.description: Platform access not permitted for your plan

501.description: Platform does not support stories

get.description: Returns live profile counts plus trailing-30-day insight totals (reach, views, interactions, engaged accounts, net follower change) for a connected Instagram account. The totals require the instagram_business_manage_insights permission, requested on every connect. Accounts connected before that permission existed return 403 platform.instagram.insights_scope_missing and must be reconnected.

403.description: Account connected without the insights permission, reconnect required

get.description: Beta. Returns the follower count plus per-post aggregate performance (impressions, unique views, likes, comments, shares, clicks, engagement rate) for a connected LinkedIn organization page. The response shape may change without notice while this endpoint is in beta.
Returns the connected Pinterest account's pins.
Returns the connected Pinterest account's public profile counts: followers, pins, boards, and monthly views.

Beta. Returns engagement metrics for a single Threads post (level=media) or for the connected account (level=account). Requires the threads_manage_insights Threads permission, which is pending Meta App Review, so calls may return an upstream authorization error for accounts outside the app's tester roster until that permission is granted. Media metrics are views, likes, replies, reposts, quotes and shares. Account metrics are those five plus clicks, followers_count and follower_demographics. shares is media-only and clicks is account-only. follower_demographics requires exactly one breakdown (country, city, age or gender) and rejects since or until.

parameters.description: Platform post ID, required when level is media
parameters.name: post_id

parameters.description: Comma-separated metric names, defaults to all metrics valid for the level
parameters.name: metric

parameters.description: One of country, city, age, gender; only valid with follower_demographics
parameters.name: breakdown

parameters.description: Unix timestamp lower bound, must be >= 1712991600
parameters.name: since

parameters.description: Unix timestamp upper bound, must be >= 1712991600
parameters.name: until

get.description: Beta. Resolves a public Threads profile by exact username and returns its public metrics. Requires the threads_profile_discovery Threads permission, which is pending Meta App Review, so calls may return an upstream authorization error for accounts outside the app's tester roster until that permission is granted. Matching is exact, with no fuzzy or prefix search. Only profiles with 100 or more followers are discoverable, anything else returns 404. The upstream budget is 1000 lookups per user per rolling 24 hours.
get.summary: Look up a public Threads profile (beta)

parameters.description: Connected account ID whose token authorizes the lookup
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.description: Exact Threads username, with or without a leading @
parameters.name: username

429.description: Lookup budget exhausted for this user

501.description: Account is not a TikTok account or connector does not support post sync

post.description: Sends an approved WhatsApp template message to a recipient phone number. Template messages can be sent outside the 24-hour customer service window. The template must already be APPROVED on the WABA, and the language code must match an approved variant. Component parameter order must match the template's placeholders. The response includes message_id, the SocialAPI message ID for the send, which matches the id field on the dm.status.* webhooks for this message.

requestBody.description: Recipient, template name, language, and components

404.description: Account not found or not owned by caller

429.description: Monthly interaction limit exceeded or platform rate limit

502.description: WhatsApp/Meta upstream error (template not approved, invalid parameters)

get.description: Returns all message templates configured on the WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) associated with this connected account. Templates include approved, pending, rejected, and paused entries. Use the after cursor from paging.cursors to fetch subsequent pages.

parameters.description: Maximum number of templates to return (1-100)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Pagination cursor (after) from a previous response
parameters.name: cursor

404.description: Account not found or not owned by caller

post.description: Submits a new message template to the WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) for review. The request body is the raw WhatsApp Cloud API template payload (name, category, language, components). New templates start in PENDING status; Meta reviews them and the status transitions to APPROVED or REJECTED asynchronously.

404.description: Account not found or not owned by caller

delete.description: Deletes a template by name from the WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) associated with this connected account. WhatsApp deletes all language variants that share the given name. Templates cannot be deleted while they are being used in active campaigns.

404.description: Account not found or template does not exist

get.description: Returns the public business profile for a WhatsApp phone number, including about text, address, description, contact email, websites, and vertical. The profile is visible to customers in the WhatsApp chat header.

parameters.description: WhatsApp phone number platform ID (numeric ID, not the E.164 number)
parameters.name: id

404.description: Phone number not owned by caller or not connected

put.description: Updates one or more fields of the public business profile (about, address, description, email, websites, vertical, profile_picture_handle). Only provided fields are changed. The profile picture itself is changed by passing a profile_picture_handle obtained from the Resumable Upload API; profile_picture_url is read-only.

parameters.description: WhatsApp phone number platform ID (numeric ID, not the E.164 number)
parameters.name: id

404.description: Phone number not owned by caller or not connected

post.description: Releases the phone number from WhatsApp Business, freeing it for use with another Business Solution Provider (BSP). This does not delete the connected account on SocialAPI; the account remains until it is disconnected explicitly.
post.summary: Deregister a phone number from WhatsApp Business

404.description: Account not found or not owned by caller

post.description: Registers a previously verified phone number with WhatsApp Business and sets the 6-digit two-step verification PIN. The phone number must be verified via verify-code first. The PIN must be retained by the caller: losing it triggers a mandatory 7-day wait before it can be reset.
post.summary: Register a phone number with WhatsApp Business

404.description: Account not found or not owned by caller

409.description: Phone number not verified or already registered with another BSP

post.description: Asks WhatsApp to send a one-time verification code to the phone number via SMS or voice call. The code is delivered to the underlying phone line, not to the API caller; follow up with verify-code once the user receives it. Step 1 of the phone-number registration flow (request-code, verify-code, register).
post.summary: Request a phone number verification code

404.description: Account not found or not owned by caller

get.description: Returns whether a phone number is verified and registered with WhatsApp Business. Used by client UIs to decide which step of the registration flow to show.

404.description: Account not found or not owned by caller

post.description: Submits the 6-digit code received via SMS or voice to prove ownership of the phone number. Once verified, the phone number can be registered with WhatsApp Business. Codes expire quickly; if verification fails, request a new code.
post.summary: Verify a phone number with a code

404.description: Account not found or not owned by caller

502.description: WhatsApp/Meta upstream error (code mismatch or expired)

post.description: Dry-run validation of a WhatsApp message template against the Cloud API rules (name format, component cardinality, header format, text limits, placeholder sequencing, button constraints). Returns errors for hard violations that WhatsApp would reject and warnings for best-practice issues. Performs no network call and does not submit the template.

get.description: Returns a single message template by its WhatsApp template ID. Any active WhatsApp account on the caller's workspace is used to authorize the lookup; the template itself is scoped by its platform ID.

404.description: Template not found or no WhatsApp account connected

put.description: Updates the components of an existing message template by its WhatsApp template ID. Only APPROVED templates can be edited, and editing resets the template to PENDING for re-review. APPROVED templates are limited to one edit per day.

404.description: Template not found or no WhatsApp account connected

501.description: Account is not a YouTube account or connector does not support post sync

patch.summary: Edit a published YouTube video (title, description, visibility, Studio tags)

requestBody.description: Editable fields (all fields optional; omit any to leave unchanged)

patch.description: Edits the text of one of the connected account's own YouTube comments via comments.update. Only the comment author (the connected account) can edit. YouTube only.

501.description: Account is not a YouTube account, or the connector does not support editing comments

post.description: Sets the moderation status of a YouTube comment (published, held_for_review, or rejected), optionally banning the author. ban_author is only valid with status=rejected. YouTube only.

requestBody.description: Moderation action (account_id and post_id are both required to resolve the channel that owns the comment)

501.description: Account is not a YouTube account, or the connector does not support comment moderation

get.description: Returns posts with rich filtering and cursor pagination. Supports filtering by status, platform, account_ids, date range, and text search.

parameters.description: Filter to posts whose targets belong to this brand
parameters.name: brand_id

parameters.description: Filter by status (draft, scheduled, publishing, published, partial, failed, cancelled)
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Filter by specific page ID (for multi-page accounts like Facebook)
parameters.name: page_id

parameters.description: Sort order: scheduled_asc (default), scheduled_desc, created_asc, created_desc
parameters.name: sort

post.description:
Creates a post for one or more connected accounts. Set `publish_now: true` to publish
immediately: the post is accepted with status `publishing` and delivery runs in the
background (so slow reel/video uploads do not block the request). The terminal status
(`published`, `partial`, or `failed`) arrives via the `post.published`/`post.partial`/
`post.failed` webhooks and by polling GET /posts/{pid}. Set `scheduled_at` to queue the
post for future publication. With neither flag the post is saved as a draft (this is the
default, even when targets are provided); publish it later with POST /posts/{pid}/publish.
Consumes 1 post credit when the post is published or scheduled; saving a draft is free.

201.description: Post accepted (publishing in background), scheduled, or drafted

207.description: Some accounts published, some failed (fast completion)

post.description: Upload a CSV file to create multiple posts. Use dry_run=true to validate without creating. Columns, in order: text, title, account_ids, scheduled_at, visibility, first_comment, platform_data, board_id. Only text is required. account_ids is pipe separated.

get.description: Returns media and text constraints for all supported platforms. Cacheable.

post.description: Dry-run validation. Returns errors for hard limit violations and warnings for best-practice issues.

get.description: Fetch a post with all platform delivery details. Accepts the SocialAPI post ID or a platform post ID (the platform's native ID for a published target).

parameters.description: SocialAPI post ID (UUID) or platform post ID
parameters.name: pid

409.description: Platform post ID matches multiple posts

delete.description: Deletes a draft/scheduled/failed post locally, or deletes a published post from every platform that supports it. Platforms that do not support deletion (or fail) keep their copy live and the post is kept (shrunk) rather than removed. Returns a per-platform result.

patch.description:
Updates the text, media, schedule time, targets, or hidden status of a pending post.
Only posts in `draft`, `scheduled`, or `failed` status can be updated.

409.description: Post is not in an editable state

get.description: Fetches live engagement metrics from platform APIs for a published post. Accepts the SocialAPI post ID or a platform post ID.

parameters.description: SocialAPI post ID (UUID) or platform post ID
parameters.name: pid

409.description: Platform post ID matches multiple posts

post.description:
Publishes a post in `draft` or `scheduled` status immediately. The post is accepted
with status `publishing` and delivery runs in the background (so slow reel/video uploads
do not block the request); the terminal status arrives via the `post.published`/
`post.partial`/`post.failed` webhooks and by polling GET /posts/{pid}. Use this to publish
a post that was saved as a draft, or to publish a scheduled post ahead of its time.
Consumes 1 post credit.

201.description: Post accepted, publishing in the background

207.description: Some accounts published, some failed (fast completion)

409.description: Post is not in a publishable state

post.description: Re-attempts publication of a post in `failed` or `partial` status. Consumes 1 post credit.

409.description: Post is not in a retryable state

post.description: Unpublishes a published post from a specific account (if account_id provided) or all accounts.

501.description: resource.not_supported: a target platform cannot unpublish (content stays live)

get.description: Returns brands, posts, and interactions consumed during the current billing period alongside the plan limits. -1 means unlimited (all paid plans). Period boundaries come from Stripe subscription or rolling 30-day windows for free users.
get.summary: Get resource usage for the current billing period

200.description: Resource usage for the current billing period

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile (id, email, plan tier, onboarding flag, beta_tester flag, allowed_platforms list, billing_blocked state).

delete.description: Permanently deletes the authenticated user account and all associated data (API keys, connected accounts, usage logs). Any active subscription is cancelled immediately, with no refund for the remainder of the current billing period. This action is irreversible.

patch.description: Updates the authenticated user's profile. Supports setting onboarding=false to mark onboarding as complete, and optionally storing use_case and referral for onboarding analytics. The response reflects the current billing_blocked state, unaffected by this update.

400.description: Invalid request body or onboarding value

get.description: Returns all webhook endpoints for the authenticated user.

post.description: Registers a new webhook endpoint and performs a live reachability ping. If the endpoint is unreachable or returns an unexpected response, the request fails with 400 (webhook_verification_failed). The generated secret is returned once - store it securely.

get.description: Returns the catalog of webhook event types you can subscribe to, grouped by category (posts, inbox, accounts).
Returns the configuration and aggregate delivery stats for a single webhook endpoint owned by the caller.

delete.description: Removes a webhook endpoint. Future events will not be delivered to this URL.

patch.description: Partially updates a webhook endpoint. All fields are optional; at least one must be provided.

get.description: Returns recent delivery attempts for a webhook endpoint. Optionally filter by status (success, failed, pending) or event_type. Cursor-paginated.
Returns the full record of a single webhook delivery attempt, including request payload, response status, response body excerpt, and timing.

post.description: Requeues a failed webhook delivery for another attempt. Returns the updated delivery record.
Sends a synthetic event payload to the webhook endpoint to validate signature, reachability, and consumer handling. Returns the delivery result.

requestBody.description: Event type and payload to send

BearerAuth.description: Prefix your API key with "Bearer ". Example: `Authorization: Bearer sapi_key_...`
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

body.example: We are upgrading our database infrastructure.

id.description:
ID is the canonical SocialAPI interaction id (sapi_cmt_…). Prefer it over
platform_id, which is retained for backward compatibility.

liked_by_viewer.description:
LikedByViewer is true when the connected account has liked this comment.
[platform: linkedin_page] false elsewhere.

moderation_status.description:
ModerationStatus is the platform's moderation state for this comment, when
exposed: "published", "held_for_review", "likely_spam", or "rejected".
Empty when unknown or not applicable. [platform: youtube]

reply_count.description:
ReplyCount is kept for backward compatibility but deprecated: prefer
HasReplies. Not all platforms report an exact count.

brand_id.description: BrandID optionally specifies which brand to attach the account to. If omitted, a new brand is auto-created.

platform.description: Platform identifies the social platform to connect (e.g. instagram, facebook, google, threads, tiktok, linkedin).

redirect_uri.description:
RedirectURI is the customer's URL to redirect the user to after OAuth completes.
If you have registered redirect URIs in the dashboard, the value must match one of them.
If you have none registered, any valid https URI is accepted. If omitted, the default HTML success page is shown.

state.description: CustomerState is an opaque value echoed back to the customer's redirect URI. Max 512 chars.

sync_state.description:
SyncState is "idle", "syncing", or "failed" for this account's
conversation-list sync. Additive: reading it never triggers a sync, and a
client that ignores it sees exactly the previous response.

brand_ids.description: BrandIDs restricts the key to specific brands. Empty means all brands.

scopes.description: Scopes restricts the key to specific actions. Empty means full access.

message.example: Store this key securely. It will not be shown again.

first_comment.description: FirstComment is auto-posted as the first comment after publishing (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube). Ignored by every other platform, and by Facebook Page Stories.

media.description:
Media is the ordered, agnostic media list. Each item is a url, a media_id,
or a platform_attachment_id; order and mixing are preserved. Supersedes media_ids.

media_ids.description:
MediaIDs are previously uploaded media file IDs to attach.

Deprecated: use Media with source_type "media_id". Ignored when media is set.

platform_data.description: PlatformData passes platform-specific fields keyed by platform name (e.g. {"instagram": {"content_type": "feed"}}). Folded into each matching target; a target's own platform_data wins on conflicts.

publish_now.description: PublishNow publishes immediately when targets are provided (ignores scheduled_at). Without this flag (and without scheduled_at) the post is saved as a draft; publish it later with POST /posts/{pid}/publish.

scheduled_at.description: ScheduledAt queues the post for future publication (RFC3339). When set, the post is scheduled rather than drafted.

segments.description: Segments are continuation posts that publish as a native thread on X. Threads chaining is temporarily unavailable.

skip_duplicate_check.description: SkipDuplicateCheck bypasses the duplicate content detection.

skip_validation.description: SkipValidation bypasses pre-publish validation. The post is scheduled/published as-is and may fail at the platform.

targets.description: Targets specifies which connected accounts to publish to, with optional per-target overrides.

text.description:
Text is the post body content. Required, unless every target supplies a
body of its own through text or a platform_data field the connector uses
as the body (e.g. Pinterest's platform_data.description IS the pin body).
text.example: Check out our new product launch! #newproduct

title.description: Title is an optional post title (used by LinkedIn, Google).

visibility.description: Visibility controls who can see the post. Platform-dependent values: public, private, connections_only, logged_in.

label.description: Label is an optional human-readable label for this URI.

uri.description: URI is the redirect URI to whitelist (must be https, or http for localhost).

events.description: Events is the list of event types to subscribe to.

url.description: URL is the HTTPS endpoint that will receive webhook POST requests.

message.example: Store the secret securely. It will not be shown again.

can_post.description: [platform: tiktok] Always false on other platforms

caption.description:
Caption is text shown with this attachment instead of as a separate message.
Supported on WhatsApp (not on audio) and Telegram; ignored on platforms whose
Send API has no caption, where an attachment is always a bare bubble.

source.description: Source is the attachment reference; its meaning is given by source_type.

source_type.description:
SourceType selects how Source is interpreted:
  - "url": Source is a publicly reachable media URL the platform fetches directly.
  - "media_id": Source is a file id in your SocialAPI media library
    (GET /v1/media); the server resolves it to a temporary URL before sending.
  - "platform_attachment_id": Source is an id of media already uploaded to the
    target platform (for example a Meta attachment_id) to reuse without re-upload.

type.description:
Type is the media kind. Optional for url and media_id sources (inferred from
the file), required for platform_attachment_id (the platform exposes no URL
to infer from).

code.description: Code is the authorization code received from the platform callback.

metadata.description: Metadata must include redirect_uri and state for CSRF validation.

platform.description: Platform identifies the social platform (must match the connect call).

category.description: Category is the location's primary Google category, localized.

details.description:
Details is the rest of what Google publishes about the location: address,
phone numbers, categories, opening hours, service area, and the Maps and
review links. Fields are omitted when Google returns no value, so a
service-area business has no storefront_address rather than an empty one.

maps_uri.description: MapsURI is the location's page on Google Maps.

total_count.description:
TotalCount carries no omitempty: zero is a real count (an empty gallery),
not an absent one.

state.description:
State is "idle", "syncing", or "failed". A finished job is idle with a
fresher LastSyncedAt; there is no terminal "done".

synced.description: Synced counts what the last completed job wrote. Display only.

profile_pic.description: ProfilePic URLs expire after a few days; never persist one as durable.

description.example: Create, edit, publish, and delete posts

sync_state.description: SyncState is "idle", "syncing", or "failed" for this thread's message sync.

lock_accounts_to_brand.description:
LockAccountsToBrand toggles whether a social account already connected to
one brand may be re-connected (moved) to a different brand. When true, such
a connect attempt is rejected with 409 account.already_linked.

use_case.example: Managing my own brand's social accounts

login_id.description:
login_id identifies the stored login and is set for both Facebook and
Google. pages and lost_access are Facebook page-selection only.

the platform exposes one (Google). Empty elsewhere.

policy_violation.description:
PolicyViolation explains a REJECTED reply, passed through verbatim from
the platform. Absent otherwise.

state.description:
State is the moderation outcome: PENDING, APPROVED, or REJECTED.
Omitted on platforms that publish replies synchronously.

media.description:
Media is the ordered, agnostic media list. Each item is a url, a media_id,
or a platform_attachment_id; order and mixing are preserved. Supersedes media_ids.

PlatformAccountID selects the Google Business Profile to connect (Google
pending connections only).

message.example: It would be great to have a dark mode.

type.description: Type is one of: bug, feature_request, general.

attachment_url.description:
AttachmentURL is a single-attachment shorthand. Ignored when attachments is
non-empty; its type is inferred from the URL extension.

Deprecated: use Attachments instead, which supersedes it and supports one or
many items.

attachments.description: Attachments sends one or more media items, each as its own message bubble.

buttons.description:
Buttons renders a button template (1-3 buttons); uses text as the bubble body.
On WhatsApp every button must be type postback with a unique payload.

cards.description: Cards renders a generic/carousel template (up to 10 cards).

list_button.description:
ListButton is the label on the button that opens the list. Required with
list_sections, max 20 characters.

list_sections.description:
ListSections renders a tappable list behind a single button, for menus wider
than the 3 buttons a reply-button message allows (up to 10 rows in total,
across up to 10 sections). WhatsApp only; requires text and list_button.

message_tag.description:
MessageTag attaches a Meta message tag so the DM can be sent outside the
standard 24-hour window. Instagram/Facebook only. Instagram accepts only
HUMAN_AGENT; Facebook also accepts ACCOUNT_UPDATE, CONFIRMED_EVENT_UPDATE,
CUSTOMER_FEEDBACK, POST_PURCHASE_UPDATE. Requires Meta "Human Agent"
advanced access for HUMAN_AGENT. Ignored by non-Meta platforms. For beta
testers replying on Facebook Messenger, HUMAN_AGENT is applied
automatically when this field is omitted.

quick_replies.description: QuickReplies renders up to 13 tappable chips above the keyboard; requires text.

reply_to_message_id.description:
ReplyToMessageID makes the first sent bubble a reply to a specific prior
message (Meta message.reply_to.mid). Instagram/Facebook only.

message_id.description:
MessageID is the first sent message's ID; for a multi-attachment send it is
only the first of several IDs.

Deprecated: use MessageIDs instead.

message_ids.description: MessageIDs holds every sent message's ID, in send order.

board_id.description:

targets use board_id; page_id is also accepted as an alias, but supplying
both is an error.

first_comment.description: FirstComment overrides the post-level first comment for this target.

Media is the ordered, agnostic media list. Each item is a url, a media_id,
or a platform_attachment_id; order and mixing are preserved. Supersedes media_ids.

media_ids.description:
MediaIDs overrides the post-level media for this target.

hidden.description: Hidden archives the post from default list views when true.

media.description:
Media is the ordered, agnostic media list. Each item is a url, a media_id,
or a platform_attachment_id; order and mixing are preserved. Supersedes media_ids.

media_ids.description:
MediaIDs replaces the attached media files.

platform_data.description: PlatformData passes platform-specific fields keyed by platform name (e.g. {"instagram": {"content_type": "feed"}}). Folded into each matching target; a target's own platform_data wins on conflicts.

scheduled_at.description: ScheduledAt changes the scheduled publication time (RFC3339).

segments.description: Segments are continuation posts that publish as a native thread on X. Threads chaining is temporarily unavailable.

text.description: Text replaces the post body. Only for draft/scheduled/failed posts.

visibility.description: Visibility changes who can see the post.

billing_blocked.description:
BillingBlocked is true when the subscription is past due and API access
plus webhook delivery are paused. Clears automatically once paid.

billing_blocked_at.description: BillingBlockedAt is when the block began, or null when not blocked.

facebook_page_selection.description:
FacebookPageSelection, when true, enables the shared-credential Facebook
connect flow (page selection) in the dashboard. Read-only here.

lock_accounts_to_brand.description:
LockAccountsToBrand, when true, rejects connecting a social account that is
already connected to another of your brands (409 account.already_linked)
instead of moving it. Default false.

account_ids.description: AccountIDs lists connected account IDs - their platforms are resolved automatically.

media.description:
Media is the ordered, agnostic media list. Each item is a url, a media_id,
or a platform_attachment_id; order and mixing are preserved. Supersedes media_ids.

media_ids.description:
MediaIDs are media file IDs to validate (checks count and type limits).

platform_data.description: PlatformData passes platform-specific fields keyed by platform name (e.g. {"instagram": {"content_type": "feed"}}). Folded into each matching target; a target's own platform_data wins on conflicts.

platforms.description: Platforms lists platform names to validate against (e.g. ["instagram", "linkedin"]).

scheduled_at.description: ScheduledAt validates the schedule time (must be in the future, within platform limits).

segments.description: Segments are continuation posts that publish as a native thread on X. Threads chaining is temporarily unavailable.

targets.description: Targets validates per-target overrides if provided.

text.description: Text is the post content to validate against platform constraints.

segment_index.description: SegmentIndex pins the issue to a continuation segment (0-based); nil for the main post.

about.description: About is the profile tagline shown in the chat header.

address.description: Address is the business address (max 256 characters).

profile_picture_url.description: ProfilePictureURL is the public URL of the current profile picture (read-only; use profile_picture_handle to update).

category.description: Category is the message category. Marketing intent in a UTILITY template triggers automatic rejection.

components.description:
Components define the template body, optional header, optional footer, and optional buttons.
At minimum one BODY component is required.

language.description: Language is the BCP-47 language code (e.g. en_US, fr_FR, pt_BR).

name.description: Name is the template identifier. Lowercase letters, digits, underscores only; no spaces.

pin.description:
PIN is the 6-digit two-step verification PIN to set on the phone number.
This PIN is required for future re-registration and must be stored securely.

language.description: Language is the BCP-47 locale used for the verification message (e.g. en_US, fr_FR).

method.description: Method is the verification channel. WhatsApp Business API requires SMS or VOICE.

components.description:
Components carries header/body/button variable substitutions.
Each component matches WhatsApp's template component schema (type + parameters).

language.description: Language is the BCP-47 code matching the template's approved language (e.g. en_US, fr_FR).

template_name.description: TemplateName is the approved template name to send.

to.description: To is the recipient phone number in E.164 format without the leading "+".

contacts.description: Contacts maps the input phone number to its canonical WhatsApp ID.

message_id.description:
MessageID is the SocialAPI message ID for the send, matching the "id"
field on the dm.status.* webhooks for this message. Empty when WhatsApp
returned no wamid or no canonical wa_id, since an ID built from half the
pair would collide across conversations.

messages.description: Messages contains one entry per delivered message, with its platform ID.

example.description:
Example carries the button's sample value(s), forwarded verbatim: a dynamic
URL example (["https://..."]) or a COPY_CODE sample ("250FF").

phone_number.description: PhoneNumber is required when Type is PHONE_NUMBER. E.164 format with leading "+".

text.description: Text is the button label. Not required for COPY_CODE (WhatsApp auto-labels it).

url.description: URL is required when Type is URL. May contain a single {{1}} placeholder.

parameters.description: Parameters lists variable substitutions for this component.

type.description: Type is the component slot: header, body, or button.

buttons.description: Buttons populate a BUTTONS component (one of QUICK_REPLY, URL, PHONE_NUMBER, COPY_CODE).

example.description:
Example carries WhatsApp's sample values, forwarded verbatim. For a TEXT
BODY/HEADER it is {"body_text":[["v1","v2"]]} / {"header_text":["v1"]}; for
a media HEADER it is {"header_handle":["<url-or-handle>"]}. Required for
approval when the component contains variables.

format.description: Format is required for HEADER components.

text.description:
Text is the literal text for HEADER (when Format is TEXT), BODY, or FOOTER components.
May contain 1-indexed placeholders such as {{1}}, {{2}}.

components.description: Components is the raw WhatsApp template component definition.

text.description: Text is the substituted value when Type is "text".

type.description: Type is the parameter type. Only "text" is supported today.

component_index.description:
ComponentIndex pins the issue to a components[] entry (0-based); nil for
top-level fields such as name, category, or language.

field.description:
Field is the offending request field (e.g. "name", "components.format",
"components.buttons[0].url").

message.description: Message is a developer-facing description of the problem.
message.example: name must contain only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (no spaces or capitals)

about.description: About is the profile tagline (max 139 characters).

address.description: Address is the business address (max 256 characters).

profile_picture_handle.description:
ProfilePictureHandle is a handle returned by the Resumable Upload API.
Use this to change the profile picture; the picture URL is read-only.

errors.description: Errors are hard violations WhatsApp would reject at submission.

valid.description: Valid is true when there are no errors (warnings do not affect validity).

warnings.description: Warnings are best-practice issues or items that cannot be fully verified offline.

code.description: Code is the 6-digit verification code received via SMS or voice.

brand_id.description: [always] Internal brand UUID this account belongs to

login_id.description: [optional] Shared credential (login) id; set for credential-backed platforms (e.g. facebook)

metadata.description: [optional] Platform-specific keys stored at connect time

name.description: [always] Display name of the account or page

page_name.description: [optional] Name of the single active page bound to this account; set only when exactly one page is active (e.g. facebook), so clients can label the tile with the page instead of the login identity

reconnect_reason.description: [optional] Human-readable reason; only set when Status == "reconnect_required"

username.description: [always] May equal Name on platforms without a distinct handle

text.example: Love this product! Really glad I found it.

ad_phone.description: AdPhone is the alternate number shown on Google Ads extensions.

can_delete.description: Capability flags, pointers for the same reason as the status flags above.

can_reopen.description: CanReopen is set on a temporarily closed location that can be reopened.

duplicate_location.description: DuplicateLocation names the location this one was flagged a duplicate of.

has_voice_of_merchant.description:
Status flags, pointers so the three states stay distinct: true, an
explicit false from Google, and absent because Google said nothing.
A plain bool with omitempty collapses the last two, which would report a
location as lacking a capability we were never actually told about.

HasVoiceOfMerchant is the one that matters operationally: when it is
false the merchant does not currently control the profile, and posting
or replying fails until they resolve it in Google Business Profile.

maps_uri.description: MapsURI is the location's Google Maps page.

new_review_uri.description:
NewReviewURI is the short link that opens the review form for this
location, for review-request campaigns.

open_status.description: OpenStatus is OPEN, CLOSED_PERMANENTLY or CLOSED_TEMPORARILY.

opening_date.description: OpeningDate is set on a location that has not opened yet.

place_id.description:
PlaceID is the standard Google Places identifier, so a location can be
joined to Places, Maps and Geocoding results.

nanos.description:
Nanos is a pointer because zero is a real value: a price of exactly
80.00 EUR has no fractional part, and omitempty would drop it.

closed.description:
Closed marks the location shut for the whole period, in which case the
times are absent. A pointer so "Google did not say" stays distinct from
an explicit "not closed".

author.description: [always] Fields are populated only when the source platform exposes them; absent fields are omitted from JSON

content.description: [always] Text may be empty for attachment-only or referral interactions

conversation_id.description: [optional] Internal conversation UUID; set by facebook/instagram inbound DM handlers when linked to a stored conversation

metadata.description: [optional] Platform-specific keys: google sets "star_rating"; facebook mentions set "permalink_url"; instagram sets "media_id" or "referral"

page_id.description: [platform: facebook] Internal SocialAPI page ID (account_pages.id) identifying which Page received the event. Set for Facebook Page-scoped events; empty for platforms without a multi-page account model (e.g. Instagram), where account_id already identifies the account.

permalink.description: [optional] Public URL of the post this interaction belongs to; set for instagram comments

platform_post_id.description: [optional] Platform-native post ID; empty when not available

post_id.description: [optional] Internal post UUID; empty when the interaction is not linked to a stored post

recipient.description: [platform: instagram] Non-nil for echo/sent DM events; nil for all other interaction types

type.description: [always] One of: comment, review, dm, mention (or dm.sent/dm.received/dm.referral for webhook events)

caption.description: [always] Post text body; may be empty for media-only posts

comments_count.description: [platform: instagram, facebook, tiktok] Zero on other platforms

like_count.description: [platform: instagram, facebook, tiktok] Zero on other platforms

media_type.description: [platform: instagram, facebook, threads, tiktok, youtube] Empty on linkedin and google

media_url.description: [platform: instagram, tiktok, youtube] Cover image or media URL; empty on facebook, threads, linkedin, google

permalink.description: [platform: instagram, facebook, threads, tiktok, youtube, google, linkedin, linkedin_page]

view_count.description: [platform: youtube, tiktok] Zero on other platforms

photos_only.description: only photo items (no video, no gif - stricter than ImagesOnly)

supports_mixed_media.description:
SupportsMixedMedia reports whether a platform_attachment_id item may be
combined with other media (url/media_id) in the same post. When false
(instagram, threads) a platform_attachment_id must be the only media item.
Meaningful only when SupportsPlatformAttachmentID is true.

mode.description:
Mode reflects the platform's native scheduling support: "native" when the
platform can schedule the post itself, "server_side" when the platform has
no native scheduling and SocialAPI holds the post and publishes it at the
scheduled time. Regardless of mode, scheduled_at is accepted whenever
Supported is true. Empty when Supported is false.

supported.description: whether scheduled_at is accepted for this platform

max_length.description: maximum allowed length (in units defined by CountingMode)

photo_max_length.description: platform-specific stricter cap for photo-mode captions (e.g. TikTok); 0 = use MaxLength
